note: This file only claims milestones backed by physical repository records. The Active Directory path is considered CORE_CONTENT_COMPLETE for the present evidence-backed core, not an assertion that every possible Microsoft AD DS feature or organization-specific procedure is covered.

paths.title: Active Directory Specialist / Senior Wintel Engineer
paths.target_role: AD Specialist / Senior Wintel Engineer / Infrastructure Engineer
entry_prerequisites: Working knowledge of Windows Server administration, TCP/IP and enterprise change control

milestones.rationale: Start with replication because AD consistency, DNS-integrated data, Group Policy and recovery all depend on understanding convergence and failure age.
Add DNS/DC Locator and site/subnet topology so authentication and replication symptoms can be traced through their network dependencies.
Build operations-master and time-hierarchy competence before advanced lifecycle or recovery decisions.
Combine Kerberos and secure-channel evidence so learners can separate identity, time, DNS and machine-trust failures.
Cover Group Policy architecture, LDAP protections and delegated OU administration as the main policy and least-privilege control plane.
Develop service-account hygiene and automation-aware identity administration with gMSA.
Cover branch RODC design, functional levels, Global Catalog considerations and domain-controller lifecycle/metadata-cleanup boundaries.
Finish technical progression with trusted backups, object/domain recovery semantics and forest-recovery readiness.
Conclude with cross-domain assessment, senior interview judgement and an enterprise health/recovery capstone rather than isolated factual recall.

paths.dependency_notes: M1-M4 establish core directory, discovery, FSMO/time and authentication reasoning. M5-M7 add policy, security and lifecycle design. M8 is intentionally late because recovery is high-impact and assumes the learner can reason about replication, DNS, FSMO and authentication dependencies. M9 is the integrated evidence gate.
paths.status_rationale: The path now has physical coverage across replication, DNS/DC Locator, sites/subnets, FSMO, time hierarchy, Kerberos, secure channels, Group Policy, LDAP security, OU delegation, gMSA, RODC, functional levels/Global Catalog, DC lifecycle, backup/restore and forest recovery, with integrated assessments, interviews and capstone evidence. Organization-specific procedures and the long tail of AD DS features remain future enrichment rather than being falsely claimed complete.
